name: energy_free_fall_is_neutral
description: The car is released at z 1500 with no boost and falls for 30 steps (2 s): it drops about 1300 uu to z 200 and reaches about 1300 uu/s. Gravity only converts height into speed, so Phi (kinetic + height) is constant at pe(1483) = 650 * 1483 / 2645000 = 0.3644. Hand calc: the potential difference is 0, only the discount leak remains: 30 * (gamma - 1) * 0.3644 = -0.0339. 'This term must never tax aerials': a fall costs nothing.

expect.intent: falling converts height into speed at no cost: only the tiny discount leak (-0.034) remains
at weight 75 the whole 2 s fall costs about -2.5, the leak only
